required.quote: Have successfully completed a planned, documented supervised practice experience in the practice of dietetics and nutrition fulfilling the competency requirements of a program in dietetics that is accredited by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics or its successor organization. Except as otherwise provided in subsection (3), the practice experience described in this subdivision must include at least 1,000 hours under the supervision of a dietitian nutritionist or a registered dietitian nutritionist.

exams.notes: Applicant must also be a registered dietitian nutritionist (i.e., hold the CDR credential).

topical_requirements.quote: the department, in consultation with the board, shall promulgate rules requiring each applicant for license renewal to complete as part of the continuing education required under subsection (1) an appropriate number of hours or courses in pain and symptom management.

available.quote: An individual who is licensed to practice a health profession in another state or in a province of Canada, who is registered in another state, or who holds a health profession specialty field license or specialty certification from another state and who applies for licensure, registration, specialty certification, or a health profession specialty field license in this state may be granted an appropriate license or registration

requirements.value: Applicant must substantially meet MI requirements; must be licensed in a state with substantially equivalent standards; and must satisfy the board as to those equivalencies.
requirements.quote: The applicant substantially meets the requirements of this article and rules promulgated under this article for licensure, registration, specialty certification, or a health profession specialty field license.

exists.quote: the department in consultation with the board shall automatically approve an academic program described in subsection (1)(a) or an applicant's supervised practice experience described in subsection (1)(c) that is accredited by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics

national_certification.quote: "Registered dietitian nutritionist" means an individual who is credentialed by the Commission on Dietetic Registration or its successor organization as a registered dietitian or registered dietitian nutritionist.

national_association.quote: Have successfully completed a didactic program in dietetics accredited by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics.

title_protection.quote: beginning 18 months after the effective date of the initial rules promulgated under this part, the following words, titles, or letters or a combination of the following words, titles, or letters, with or without qualifying words or phrases, are restricted in use only to a dietitian nutritionist: "licensed dietitian nutritionist", "dietitian nutritionist", "dietitian", "dietician", "nutritionist", or "l.d.n.".

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence or failure to exercise due care, including negligent delegation or supervision, whether or not injury results.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a violation of general duty, consisting of negligence or failure to exercise due care, including negligent delegation to or supervision of employees or other individuals, whether or not injury results

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of the health profession.
Substance use disorder as defined in the mental health code.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: substance use disorder as that term is defined in section 100d of the mental health code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical inability adversely affecting the ability to practice safely and competently.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical inability reasonably related to and adversely affecting the licensee's or registrant's ability to practice in a safe and competent manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Declaration of mental incompetence by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Declaration of mental incompetence by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a qualifying misdemeanor or felony, including drug-related offenses.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a misdemeanor punishable by imprisonment for a maximum term of 2 years; conviction of a misdemeanor involving the illegal delivery, possession, or use of a controlled substance; or conviction of any felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or renewing a license or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or renewing a license or registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a license or registration to be used by an unauthorized person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting a license or registration to be used by an unauthorized person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice outside the scope of a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice outside the scope of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees for referral of patients or accepting kickbacks on medical or surgical services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees for referral of patients or accepting kickbacks on medical or surgical services, appliances, or medications purchased by or in behalf of patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation to a consumer or patient in the course of professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation to a consumer or patient or in obtaining or attempting to obtain third-party reimbursement in the course of professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual conduct with a patient while acting within the health profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct by a licensee or registrant with a patient while the licensee or registrant is acting within the health profession for which the licensee or registrant is licensed or registered...that is sexual or may reasonably be interpreted as sexual

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of, or aiding and abetting in violation of, this article or rules promulgated thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation, or aiding or abetting in a violation, of this article or of a rule promulgated under this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adverse administrative action by a licensure or disciplinary board in another state or jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Final adverse administrative action by a licensure, registration, disciplinary, or certification board involving the holder of, or an applicant for, a license or registration regulated by another state or a territory of the United States

definition_quote.value: "Practice of dietetics and nutrition" means the integration and application of scientific principles derived from the study of food, nutrition, biochemistry, metabolism, nutrigenomics, physiology, food systems and management, and from behavioral and social sciences in achieving and maintaining health throughout the lifespan and in providing nutrition care services, including the practice of medical nutrition therapy, for the prevention, management, and treatment of diseases or medical conditions.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of dietetics and nutrition" means the integration and application of scientific principles derived from the study of food, nutrition, biochemistry, metabolism, nutrigenomics, physiology, food systems and management, and from behavioral and social sciences in achieving and maintaining health throughout the lifespan and in providing nutrition care services, including the practice of medical nutrition therapy, for the prevention, management, and treatment of diseases or medical conditions.

value: Dietary and nutrition counseling and education
Development and administration of nutrition care standards and systems
Ordering laboratory tests to check and track nutrition status
Ordering medical laboratory tests related to nutritional therapeutic treatment
Prescription drug dose adjustments under approved protocols
methods_authorized.quote: Practice of dietetics and nutrition does not include the medical differential diagnosis of the health status of an individual but does include each of the following: (i) Nutrition assessment. (ii) Nutrition diagnosis. (iii) Nutrition support. (iv) Dietary and nutrition counseling and education. (v) Nutrition intervention. (vi) Nutrition monitoring and evaluation. (vii) Development and administration of nutrition care standards and systems.

drug_authority.value: May implement prescription drug dose adjustments for specific disease treatment protocols under approved protocols and prescriber delegation; shall not prescribe or initiate drug treatment except as provided.
drug_authority.quote: The dietitian nutritionist may implement prescription drug dose adjustments for specific disease treatment protocols within the limits of the dietitian nutritionist's knowledge, skills, judgment, and informed clinical practice guidelines as indicated in a facility, medical staff, or medical director approved protocol and as approved by and under the delegation of a prescriber.

license_type_structure.quote: an individual seeking licensure as a dietitian nutritionist shall meet all of the following requirements

provisional_license_available.quote: the board may grant a temporary license to an applicant who meets all requirements for licensure under this part except an examination or other evaluation procedure.

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: A temporary license granted under this section is valid for 1 year and is not renewable.

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: The holder of a temporary license granted under this section shall practice under the supervision of a licensee who holds a license other than a limited license or temporary license.

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: An individual who, on the day before the effective date of the amendatory act that added this part, has and continues to be a registered dietitian nutritionist in good standing, is eligible for licensure as a dietitian nutritionist under this part.

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: "Practice of medical nutrition therapy" means the provision of nutrition care services for the treatment or management of diseases or medical conditions.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: The dietitian nutritionist may order patient diets, including oral therapeutic diets, and enteral and parenteral nutrition therapy of specialized intravenous solutions and associated nutrition-related services, including, but not limited to, placing nasogastric and nasoenteric feeding tubes, as part of a therapeutic diet.

diet_order_writing_authority.quote: The dietitian nutritionist may order patient diets, including oral therapeutic diets, and enteral and parenteral nutrition therapy of specialized intravenous solutions and associated nutrition-related services

lab_test_ordering_authority.quote: The dietitian nutritionist may conduct swallow screens and order medical laboratory tests related to a nutritional therapeutic treatment as provided by the laws of this state.

physician_referral_required.quote: The dietitian nutritionist may accept or transmit orders related to the practice of medical nutrition therapy from a referring health professional licensed under this article, as established in rules promulgated by the department in consultation with the board.

diagnosis_treatment_prohibition.quote: Practice of dietetics and nutrition does not include the medical differential diagnosis of the health status of an individual

telehealth_practice_authorized.quote: "Telehealth" means the use of electronic information and telecommunication technologies to support or promote long-distance clinical health care

direct_supervision_defined.quote: At a minimum, be physically on-site and present where the supervisee is providing nutrition care services or be immediately and continuously available to the supervisee by means of 2-way real-time audiovisual technology that allows for the direct, contemporaneous interaction by sight and sound between the qualified supervisor and the supervisee.

value: physicians and other licensed health professionals acting within their scope of practice
individuals providing general nonmedical nutrition information
individuals providing evaluation and guidance on food, food materials, or dietary supplements
individuals providing medical weight control for prediabetes or obesity under an approved program
individuals providing delegated medical weight control services under a plan of care
employees assisting a dietitian nutritionist under appropriate supervision
individuals providing general nonmedical nutrition information, guidance, wellness coaching
students pursuing educational requirements under qualified supervision
individuals fulfilling supervised practice experience requirements for licensure
health food store operators or employees providing verbal nutrition information
exempt_professions_list.quote: In addition to the exemptions from licensure under section 16171, subsection (1) does not prevent any of the following: (a) A physician or other individual licensed under any other part or any other act from performing activities that are considered the practice of medical nutrition therapy if those activities are within the individual's scope of practice

federal_employee_exemption.quote: An individual who is practicing a health profession in the discharge of official duties while in the military service of the United States, the United States Public Health Service, the United States Department of Agriculture, or the United States Department of Veterans Affairs.

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: An individual from providing medical weight control for prediabetes or obesity to individuals under a program of instruction that is approved in writing by 1 of the following: (i) A dietitian nutritionist. (ii) A health professional licensed under this article whose scope of practice otherwise authorizes the health professional to provide nutrition care services

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: An individual from doing either of the following: (i) Providing verbal nutrition information as an operator or employee of a health food store or business that sells health products, including, but not limited to, dietary supplements, food, herbs, or food materials.

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: An individual who resides in another state or country and is authorized to practice a health profession in that state or country who, in an exceptional circumstance, is called in for consultation or treatment by a health professional in this state.

protected_titles.quote: the following words, titles, or letters or a combination of the following words, titles, or letters, with or without qualifying words or phrases, are restricted in use only to a dietitian nutritionist: "licensed dietitian nutritionist", "dietitian nutritionist", "dietitian", "dietician", "nutritionist", or "l.d.n.".

nutrition_assessment_includes_biochemica.quote: "Nutrition assessment" means the ongoing, dynamic, and systematic process of obtaining, verifying, and interpreting biochemical, anthropometric, physical, nutrigenomic, and dietary data

hospital_order_authority_requires_policy.quote: The dietitian nutritionist may implement prescription drug dose adjustments for specific disease treatment protocols within the limits of the dietitian nutritionist's knowledge, skills, judgment, and informed clinical practice guidelines as indicated in a facility, medical staff, or medical director approved protocol

ethics_code_violation_grounds_for_discip.quote: Promulgate rules to establish a code of ethics for licensees.
